job.title: Group Finance Manager
job.description:
Group Finance Manager – Morley, Leeds

Salary: Up to £67,500 depending on experience + car allowance/company car + bonus

I'm working with an established and successful, privately owned housebuilding business to recruit an experienced Group Finance Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, working closely with senior management and playing an important role in the financial performance of a business.

The company operates across two regions and is looking for someone who can combine strong financial management skills with commercial awareness, leadership and a proactive, hands-on approach.

This is a key appointment within the senior finance team, offering genuine responsibility, autonomy and the opportunity to influence financial performance and decision-making across the business.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Finance Director and managing a small finance team, you'll take responsibility for overseeing financial reporting, cash flow and financial planning across two regional operations.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Overseeing the preparation of monthly management accounts, including profit and loss, balance sheet reporting and financial controls.

  • Managing cash flow forecasting, budgeting and financial planning across both regions.

  • Monitoring site and project performance, including valuations, work in progress and cost-to-complete forecasts.

  • Working closely with regional directors and operational teams to provide financial insight and support commercial decisions.

  • Reviewing financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying risks and challenging assumptions.

  • Leading, supporting and developing members of the finance team.

  • Supporting statutory reporting, year-end accounts, audit and financial compliance.

  • Ensuring consistency in financial reporting and processes across both regions.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve financial systems, reporting and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a qualified accountant with strong financial management experience, ideally gained within housebuilding, construction or a similar project-based business.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • ACCA or CIMA qualification.

  • Strong experience in management accounts, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management.

  • Experience within housebuilding or construction would be a significant advantage.

  • A good understanding of project accounting, including work in progress, site valuations and cost-to-complete reporting.

  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to interpret financial information to support business decisions.

  • Confidence working with senior management and challenging financial and operational performance.

  • Previous experience managing, supporting and developing finance teams.

  • Excellent communication, organisational and analytical skills.

  • A proactive, confident approach with the ability to take ownership and work across multiple business areas.

Experience of COINS accounting software would be advantageous, although training will be provided.

Applications are welcomed from experienced Finance Managers as well as strong Financial Controllers who are ready to take the next step in their careers.

Above all, we're looking for someone commercially aware, confident and approachable, who can build strong working relationships and manage the financial demands of a busy, multi-site business.

What's on Offer?

  • Salary up to £67,500 depending on experience.

  • £6,000 annual car allowance or company car.

  • Bonus scheme of up to 20%.

  • 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays.

  • Option to purchase up to five additional days' annual leave.

  • 5% pension.

  • Life assurance at twice annual salary.

  • Access to an employee assistance programme.

  • Salary sacrifice pension option.

  • A senior, influential position within an established, privately owned business.

  • The opportunity to work closely with the Finance Director and senior operational management.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their finance career, with responsibility across two regions and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the business.

Location: Morley, Leeds (office-based, with occasional regional travel)

Job Type: Permanent, Full-time

The customer-facing element is particularly important. You’ll need to be comfortable approaching customers, conducting interviews and encouraging people to get involved in video content, testimonials and customer stories.

Experience with paid LinkedIn campaigns, HubSpot or another CRM, marketing automation, photography, SEO or B2B marketing would be advantageous.

Working Environment

The role will initially be fully onsite in LS15, allowing you to gain a thorough understanding of the business, its customers, teams and wider operation.

Once you are fully trained and established in the position, there will be the opportunity to move to a hybrid working arrangement.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing business in a genuinely varied marketing role where you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute ideas and see the impact of your work.

You’ll have the freedom to create content from scratch, work directly with customers and collaborate with different areas of the business to deliver marketing activity that supports real commercial growth.

If you have strong digital marketing experience, a passion for content creation and the confidence to bring customer stories to life, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experienced personal tax professional looking for a role where you can take ownership of your clients while still having the support of an experienced tax team around you?

We're working with a well-established independent accountancy practice in Leeds to recruit a Personal Tax Senior / Senior Tax Accountant.

We're deliberately keeping an open mind on job titles and qualifications. You might currently be working as a Personal Tax Senior, Tax Senior, Tax Adviser, Tax Accountant or Assistant Manager – or perhaps you're an experienced practice accountant whose role includes a significant amount of personal tax.

What matters most is that you have good hands-on personal tax experience gained within accountancy practice and are comfortable dealing directly with clients.

The Role

You'll take responsibility for a varied portfolio of personal tax clients, including individuals, company directors and clients of the wider accounts team.

A large part of the role is personal tax compliance. You'll manage the Self Assessment process from start to finish, obtaining information from clients, preparing accurate returns, dealing with queries and making sure deadlines are met.

You'll have support from experienced senior colleagues when you need it, while having the autonomy to manage your own clients and workload.

Depending on your existing experience, you'll also have the opportunity to become involved in trusts, estates, partnerships, Capital Gains Tax and more complex tax matters.

There is advisory work within the team too. You don't need to arrive as an advisory tax specialist – the important thing is having strong compliance foundations and the ability to recognise when a client's circumstances may require further tax advice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Managing your own portfolio of personal tax clients
  • Preparing and submitting Self Assessment tax returns
  • Taking ownership of the tax return process from start to finish
  • Liaising directly with clients and HMRC
  • Reviewing tax calculations, coding notices, statements and repayments
  • Dealing with Capital Gains Tax matters where appropriate
  • Preparing trust, estate and partnership returns depending on your experience
  • Identifying potential tax issues and opportunities for further advice
  • Working alongside the Tax Manager and Tax Partners on more complex matters
  • Building strong, long-term client relationships
  • Supporting more junior members of the team where appropriate
  • Managing deadlines and your own workload effectively
  • Assisting with new client onboarding and relevant AML requirements

Experience, Skill Set and/or Qualifications

We're interested in speaking to people with solid personal tax experience gained within an accountancy practice.

You don't necessarily need to be CTA qualified and we're not looking for somebody who already knows absolutely everything.

You could be a strong Personal Tax Senior looking for your next move, an experienced Tax Adviser wanting more responsibility, an Assistant Manager who still enjoys hands-on client work, or a practice accountant whose experience has included significant responsibility for personal tax.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Several years' personal tax experience within accountancy practice
  • Good practical knowledge of Self Assessment and personal tax compliance
  • Experience managing your own clients or taking significant responsibility for a portfolio
  • Confidence communicating directly with clients
  • The ability to organise your workload and work to tax deadlines
  • A proactive and professional approach

Experience of trusts, estates, partnerships, CGT or tax planning would be useful, but we don't expect every candidate to have experience across every area.

ACA, ACCA, CTA, ATT or similar qualifications would be welcomed, but relevant practical experience is equally important.

What's on offer?

  • Salary up to £50,000 depending on experience
  • One day per week working from home
  • Free on-site parking
  • Established and supportive tax team
  • Direct client responsibility and genuine autonomy
  • Opportunity to broaden your technical tax experience
  • Exposure to advisory work alongside experienced Tax Managers and Partners
  • Ongoing professional development
  • Friendly, independent practice environment

Contract Information

  • Location: Leeds, within easy reach of the city centre
  • Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

If you've built good personal tax experience in practice but aren't sure whether you tick every box, we'd still be very happy to have a conversation.
